line_items.flag: Out-of-network anesthesia at an in-network surgery center — you should only owe your in-network share.
Given by the same out-of-network anesthesiologist, so the same protection applies.

overcharge_flags: Lines 1-2: an out-of-network anesthesiologist at an in-network surgery center can't bill you the out-of-network balance. Your in-network share is at most $1,780, not $2,700.
summary: Sample analysis: this $2,700 anesthesia bill is a surprise bill. Your surgery center was in network, so the No Surprises Act limits you to your in-network cost sharing: at most $1,780 (your remaining $1,550 deductible, then 20% of the rest), and less if the in-network rate is lower.
